title: Missing EPIPE handling
detail: The original code handled an OSError with errno.EPIPE by silencing flush errors and exiting with code 1. The new code only re-raises the exception when the error is not EPIPE, leaving EPIPE unhandled. This causes a broken pipe to propagate as an unhandled exception instead of exiting gracefully.

title: Potential crash on empty ignored_nodes
detail: If `ignored_nodes` is empty, accessing `ignored_nodes[-1]` raises an IndexError, causing the formatter to crash on files with an unclosed `# fmt: off` block that has no ignored nodes.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: DeferredLock exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. The condition always evaluates to True, causing the lock to be acquired twice and potentially deadlocking.
